The Hijacker is a daring individual employed by the Scorpion Cell whose primary role is to steal enemy vehicles. To do this, they can disguise themselves as almost any enemy infantry.
They are used by the Scorpion Cell.

entries.name: HMG tower
entries.content: The HMG Tower is a neutral defensive structure that, when captured by an Engineer, is basically a pair of heavy machine guns mounted on top of a tall tower.

entries.name: Horizon Destroyer
entries.content:
The Horizon-class Destroyer serves as the Allied fleet's backbone, balancing armor, firepower, and versatility. Its 155mm cannon engages enemy ships and bombards coastal targets safely beyond retaliation range. Equipped with advanced sonar, it detects hidden submarines, while its onboard V-22 Osprey drops depth charges to eliminate underwater threats. Ideal for naval dominance and coastal support, the Horizon ensures Allied control of the seas.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Hospital
entries.content:
The neutral Hospital is a neutral structure that, when captured, allows the owner side's infantry to heal themselves on the field.
The neutral Hospital have two variants: field and civilian (the latter is simply known as a Hospital). Both only differ in appearance and locations (Field Hospitals are found in non-urban environments and the opposite for the civilian Hospital) and are otherwise identical.

entries.name: Hummingbird
entries.content:
The Hummingbird is a fast allied support jet. Coming straight from the secret SteinsTech labs, the Hummingbird is a result of another joint project developed by the European scientists: the fastest jet the Allied air force ever had, capable of putting its enemies into a time warp, where they move and fire much slower than usual. Unlike the Cryocopter, the Hummingbird's weapon has instant effects and works on a small area instead of a single target, however the aircraft is incapable of doing anything to the enemy structures and like the other jets has to reload its weapon at the airfields.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Hunter-seeker
entries.content:
The Hunter-Seeker is a kamikaze drone which seeks a random enemy ground target and purposely crashes itself onto it, causing high damage, and also releasing a cryo payload in a large radius around the target area to deal as much damage as possible to nearby enemies. While the Hunter-Seeker drone travels to its target, it will fire lasers at nearby enemy units, which are effective against infantry.
It is used by the Pacific Front.

entries.name: Hyperion
entries.content:
The Hyperion is Pacific Front's exclusive advanced principle anti-aircraft defense, which can quickly deal heavy damage to enemy aircraft of all sorts, with its powerful thermal inversion cannon that stands on a cross-like concrete basis. However, due to its features of fast response, powerful continuous fire and long attack range, the Hyperion is very resource-heavy to maintain. Thus, only two such devices can be present at once on the battlefield.
It is used by the Foehn Revolt.

entries.name: Industrial Plant
entries.content:
Advancements in robotics allow Soviet commanders to build Industrial Plants: buildings which provide high tech construction drones, allowing for 25% increase in production speed and 25% cost decrease for all vehicles, ships and aircraft.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Infector tank
entries.content:
The Infector Tank is a tracked Chinese support vehicle. Despite its name, it is not an actual tank). the ECM turret located at the back of it's hull allow it to jam enemy weapons and disable enemy structures, although it could not block enemy support powers around it yet.
It is used by China and the Foehn Revolt

entries.name: Inferno Tower
entries.content:
Inferno Towers are complex defenses which utilize the pyrokinetic techniques of Epsilon to punch through armored forces and instantly dismember infantry. The exact technology behind the weapon is kept in secret by Epsilon, however the effects of it are obvious.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Infiltrator
entries.content:
The Infiltrators are Epsilon's agents of espionage and intelligence gathering, slipping through enemy ranks, "borrowing" important technology, stealing money, or sabotaging facilities. Much like their Allied and Soviet cousins, the Infiltrator can disguise himself as an enemy soldier in order to sneak into guarded buildings. What sets an Infiltrator apart from the rest though, is their ability to covertly destroy bridges, allowing them to limit an enemy's movement on the battlefield.
They are used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Initiate
entries.content:
Mind-controlled and forced to do his bidding, Initiates are fiercely loyal to the Epsilon cause. They consist mostly of ordinary soldiers augmented with psychic apparatuses attached to their spinal cords that allow them to create and manipulate fire with thought alone. This allows Initiates to ignite enemy infantry with ease by focusing their foughts on firing from a special round mental projector surgically embedded in their foreheads and even put the heat on lightly armored vehicles. They wear grey full-body uniforms with brown leather gloves, purple armbands with the Epsilon Army logo and purple round goggles. A tan face-covering facemask with a padded texture is attached to their uniforms.
They are used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Invader
entries.content:
Epsilon's primary aircraft and immediately one of the stranger weapons of Yuri, the Invader strongly resembles a classic U.F.O. from the late 40's. But these units have far more insidious intentions than just abducting cows and drunken farmers. These floating discs are armed with a unique beam weapon that dissolves organic material, causing flesh to deteriorate and armor to take substantial damage.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Irkalla
entries.content:
When Yuri learned his foes might develop colossal anti-psi weapons, he ordered the creation of the Aerial Fortress Irkalla—a saucer-like floating mechanical behemoth designed to crush threats and safeguard his ambitions. This flying titan wields multiple dissolver beams for air superiority and three Supernova cannons for ground devastation, earning its brutal reputation from debut. More terrifyingly, Irkallas now appear en masse, forcing Allied and Soviet forces into grueling battles. As both offensive juggernaut and guardian of Yuri’s ultimate weapon, it embodies his uncontested dominance—turning the tide of war with raw, overwhelming force.
It is used by Epsilon HQ.

entries.name: Iron Curtain Device
entries.content:
The previous iteration of the Iron Curtain Device was a huge success for the Soviets and warranted an upgrade. Now capable of making up to nine vehicles or a few buildings impervious to damage, with an increased shield, yet still temporary duration and immunity to mind control, the Iron Curtain is a bigger threat than ever.
The iron curtain device itself resembles a round facility with a steel spherical generator with connected wires enveloped in pulsing, red energy.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Iron Guard
entries.content:
Developed as a counter to Allied stealth tech, this defensive structure applies Iron Curtain principles to create a localized invulnerability field for nearby vehicles. Resembling a scaled-down Second Great War prototype, it renders protected units indestructible while powered and in range.
However, its high energy demands and experimental nature strictly limit simultaneous deployments. A stopgap solution when concealment fails, trading subtlety for brute-force protection.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Jackal Racer
entries.content:
A pivotal Foehn, formerly Chinese aircraft, the Jackal Racer combines speed and versatility. Its four windspin engines located at the back of it's long hull (compatible with Spinblades) enable extreme velocity and hover-based amphibious movement, making it one of the fastest transports.
It carries infantry who can fire from inside, while its crystal-amplified sonic wave instantly vaporizes enemy troops and damages all targets in its path—even while moving. Though expensive and lightly armored, its hit-and-run prowess and amphibious transport role make it invaluable.
It is used by the Foehn Revolt.

entries.name: Jaguar tank
entries.content:
The Jaguar, befitting of its name, is a nimble light tank made by the Latin Confederation and used primarily in jungle warfare. Capable of cutting through the brush at high speeds, the tank can ambush and quickly take down its prey. Its low cost allows it to be produced in mass numbers, though its fairly poor armor means it has to rely on its quick movements to evade destruction.
Even if the Jaguar is destroyed, a surprise awaits the foes of the Latin Confederation. The driver can often escape relatively unharmed thanks to a myriad of fail safes, allowing him to capture any empty vehicles on the battlefield. In dire situations, all Jaguar drivers are equipped with explosive vests for a last ditch attempt to cripple or wound enemies.
It is used by the Latin Confederation.

entries.name: Kamaz truck
entries.content:
The Kamaz is a six wheeled armored cargo truck of Russian origin widely used by the Soviet Union and the Epsilon Army. Visually, it resembles the Kamaz Typhoon series of vehicles.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions and all three Epsilon subfactions.

entries.name: Kanegawa industries
entries.content:
Kanegawa Industries (KI) is a Japanese arms manufacturer supporting the Pacific Front. Ravaged by war, its projects faced frequent setbacks, splitting the company—overseas branches allied with the Allies, while mainland Japan operations were first controlled by China, then the Foehn Revolt.
Before the Third Great War, KI researched particle collision weapons and reverse-engineered American tech (Future Tanks, Harbingers). China’s invasion forced cooperation under Japan’s non-aggression pact, though their joint efforts remained unnoticed. Later, KI worked with Yunru’s team to develop unique Chinese military gear in Kashmir, separate from Soviet arms. However, Soviet and Epsilon Army attacks destroyed their base and most Iron Dragon vehicles—the pinnacle of their particle research—halting progress.

entries.name: Kappa tank
entries.content:
The Kappa Hover Tank is the main battle tank of the Pacific Front equipped with a 105mm cannon. Unlike the other main battle tanks, it has hover propulsions, allowing it to float over water and participate in naval battles.
It is used by Pacific Front.

entries.name: Kirov
entries.content:
Kirovs, named after the great general of the Second Great War Sergei Kirov, are an iconic image recognized by all. Slow, powerful and incredibly durable, these bomber blimps represent the overwhelming firepower and intimidating presence of the Soviet Union. A fleet of Kirovs is often a sign of impending doom for any commander. Only mass amounts of heavy anti-aircraft fire is capable of downing these blimps. Their role in the invasion of the United States brought a quick success in favor of the Soviets.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Knightframe
entries.content:
The Knightframe is the backbone of Foehn infantry—a soldier equipped with a tall mechanical exosuit enhancing speed, durability, and survivability. Its integrated heavy machine gun is effective against infantry, light armor, and aircraft. Designed for frontline combat, the Knightframe allows troops to endure harsh battles while maintaining mobility and firepower.
They are used by the Foehn Revolt.

entries.name: Krukov & Reznov
entries.content:
Colonels Krukov and Reznov are two high ranking soviet officers who are good friends of The Soviet General.
Krukov wears a trenchcoat and a soviet officer's cap, along with a gas mask.
Reznov wears a blue VDV beret, along with a soviet telnyashka uniform. He also wears a gas mask
Krukov specializes in medium-range fighting using his Desolator cannon, while throwing his array of smoke grenades at the enemy, while Krukov prefers to engage his enemies at close range with an SVD sniper rifle, while still being capable of demolishing buildings via his C4.
They both fight for Soviet Russia.

entries.name: Kuznetsov Dreadnought
entries.content:
Kuznetsov Dreadnoughts are the main command ships of the Soviet Navy. Easily able to lay waste to shore targets with their high-yield ballistic missiles, Kuznetsovs played an integral role in the initial assault on the United States. Outfitted with advanced sensors and communication arrays, the Kuznetsov Dreadnought is capable of detecting stealthed or submerged enemies. Though its missiles are powerful, they can be shot down with sufficient anti-aircraft defenses. Kuznetsovs are durable, but are very sluggish due to their mass, making them vulnerable to other ships or enemy aircraft.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Lasher Tank
entries.content:
The Lasher Light Tank, originally a discarded Soviet design, was revived by Yuri’s forces after acquiring old blueprints. Serving as the backbone of PsiCorps’ armored divisions, it features a rear-mounted turret and an anti-mine flail at the front, earning its name. Its unique reload system allows four rapid shots before reverting to standard fire rates, making it deadly in ambushes. Despite being a light tank, it boasts superior armor compared to other Epsilon basic tanks, enhancing its survivability in combat.
It is used by PsiCorps.

entries.name: Latin Confederation
entries.content: The Latin Confederation, is an alliance of South American communist states that, was formed after U.S. influence waned. Lacking advanced tech from Soviet allies, it relies on guerrilla tactics, napalm, smoke cover, and elite infantry like sharpshooter Colonel José Arcadio Morales. Originating from communist uprisings post-Second Great War, the Confederation unified Latin states and joined the reformed Soviet Union. It supported Russia’s U.S. campaign and later aided Soviet efforts in Europe, capturing strategic cities and resources in Africa. In the Mental Omega War, the Confederation suffered severe losses, including its African and European HQs, but salvaged operations by rescuing Morales and destroying Epsilon cloning facilities in Rio. After retreating to South America, they struck Epsilon in Chicago, briefly regaining ground for the Soviets. Despite outdated equipment, their agility and fierce tactics made them a significant force across multiple global conflicts.

entries.name: Leviathan-class helicopter carrier
entries.content:
The Leviathan-class helicopter carrier is the Foehn navy's huge capital ship. It carries two Helibots that bombards enemies from afar with plasma cannons.
Unlike any of the other capital ships, the Leviathan can move faster when supported with Spinblades and releases nanoids to repair itself when damaged. It can also make use of Last Bastion's Nanocharge to improve its self-repair capability and also repair nearby ships.
It is used by all three Foehn Subfactions.

entries.name: Libra
entries.content:
Libra, a genetically engineered young girl created by Yuri on the moon, stands as Epsilon's most formidable psychic operative, potentially surpassing even Yuri in raw power—though her fractured psyche prevents mind control. Weaponizing telekinesis, she hurls explosive darts with lethal precision. Her passive abilities include a kinetic shield deflecting bullets and levitation over water, augmented by a spinal Cerebral Amplifier/Suppressor that both boosts and restrains her powers.
When overwhelmed by armor, she can disable the suppressor, unleashing a devastating gravity field that crumples tanks and warships (though infantry remain unaffected). Yet her volatility renders her a danger to allies and enemies alike. Prone to violent mood swings and sadism, Libra fights alongside genetically engineered clones—the only beings resistant to her psychic dissonance.
She is 5'2'', has grey short unkempt hair and a special mechanical tail that acts as a plug for her constantly connected cyindrical Cerebral Suppressor. She wears a fluffy grey hoodie with special small "horns" in it's hood that act as mini-psychic dampeners. She is generally unpredictable and highly neurotic, having a very childish demeanor.

entries.name: Machine shop
entries.content: The neutral Machine Shop is a neutral structure that, when captured by an Engineer, allows the machines oif those who control it to repair themselves on the field.

entries.name: Magnetron
entries.content:
The Magnetron is PsiCorps' magnetic warfare vehicle, harnessing Earth's magnetic field to hover and traverse water via powerful electromagnets. Its magnetic turret emits a beam that can dismantle structures or reverse polarity to magnetize enemy armor, pinning them down and attracting nearby units—with multiple Magnetrons amplifying the effect. However, it’s ineffective against most infantry due to low iron content in blood, only affecting heavily armored troops. Combining siege power and amphibious mobility, the Magnetron is a unique fusion of magnetic science and battlefield dominance.
It is used by PsiCorps.

entries.name: Malver
entries.content:
A legendary figure whispered about in fear, Malver is a desert warrior whose solitary existence in the Western Sahara was only recently confirmed—most who encountered him never survived. Long affiliated with Rashidi’s Scorpion Cell, he joined Epsilon through their alliance with Yuri, although he himself is loyal strictly to Rashidi. Following the Scorpion Cell's defection from Epsilon, Malver sided with Rashidi and is now waging a one-man war against Epsilon forces in Africa.
A self-taught psychic, he mastered psychokinesis through years of meditation, forging an invisible molecular blade that slices through armor effortlessly. His abilities also weaken foes, dulling their minds and bodies. Enhanced with a portable Chimera Core, he moves unseen—by eye or radar—making him the Scorpion Cell's deadliest assassin.

entries.name: Mandjet
entries.content:
The Mandjet is the Epsilon's amphibious transport vehicle. Unlike the Allied and Soviet transports, Mandjets sacrifice any defensive measures in favor of advanced propulsion drives, resulting in a higher cruise speed. Its main advantage reveals itself whener a Shadow Ring is cast on it, turning it into a stealth vehicle transport temporarily.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Mantis tank
entries.content:
The Mantis Scrap Tank is an ultra-cheap, mass-producible battle tank employed by the Scorpion Cell and designed for swarming tactics. Its hull combines "smart" polymers and nanofibers, making it fragile but allowing rapid armor repair—friendly Mantises can scavenge wreckage to patch damage when their voltage-controlled structure becomes malleable. While fast and expendable, its flimsy armor can barely withstand light fire. This makes the Mantis ideal for overwhelming numbers rather than durability, striking quickly like its insect namesake before retreating or being replaced.
It is used by the Scorpion Cell.

entries.name: Marauder tank
entries.content:
The Marauder tank was designed by Epsilon to protect PsiCorps' hidden bases from land and sea threats. Featuring a round turret and a unique four-track layout (two front, two rear), it wields a devastating pyrokinetic beam capable of piercing any armor. Its powerful engine grants blazing speed but leaves its rear vulnerable—earning Soviet mockery as "the tank without pants." Anti-gravity plates enable amphibious movement, making it a deadly, fast-strike vehicle ideal for counteroffensives. Despite its light armor, the Marauder excels as a swift, lethal force on any battlefield.
It is used by PsiCorps.

entries.name: Mastermind
entries.content:
The Mastermind is a horrific Psicorps weapon created by harvesting and fusing the brains of dead Epsilon Adepts into a massive, lab-grown cortex. Implanted in a tank chassis, the surviving dominant mind wields immense psychic power to control up to three enemies at once. However, exceeding this limit causes catastrophic overheating, destroying the vehicle. This monstrous fusion of biology and machinery turns the saying "A mind is a terrible thing to waste" into a terrifying reality, as enslaved brains become weapons of war—until their own power consumes them. 
It is used by PsiCorps.

entries.name: Mastodon
entries.content:
Developed by Yunru for the Great Rewrite project, the Mastodon is the largest and heaviest battle tank ever deployed, with a turret making up a third of its weight. Its plasma railgun requires charging before firing, excelling at long-range tank destruction while drawing enemy fire to protect allies. The turret also houses emergency nanomachines for repairs, most effective when stationary. 
It is used by the Foehn Revolt and some elements of the Chinese Army.

entries.name: MCV
entries.content:
The Mobile Construction Vehicle, or MCV, is the most vital component in any military operation. The MCV is a massive vehicle with the ability to deploy into the Construction Yard, the heart of any base. With it, a commander can create any military building they see fit. Protecting the MCV is a must if you wish to maintain any presence on the battlefield. Due to the technology and resources used in an MCV, the cost of building one is very high, but the expanding of your base using another MCV may prove more useful than you think. The MCV provides all the necessary materials to build a base.
A variation of the MCV is employed by every faction and subfaction. The function of each faction's MCV being the exact same, with the only difference being only in the MCV's overall design and aesthetic appearance.

entries.name: Mental Omega Device
entries.content: The Mental Omega Device (Yuri’s Tower/Babel) is a colossal psychic structure located in Epsilon's Antarctic HQ. It was developed by Yuri as his ultimate weapon. it's main ability being to facilitate global mind control by immensely amplifying the range and power of Psychic Beacons/Amplifiers, thereby enabling planetary domination through global mind control.

entries.name: Mental Omega War
entries.content: The Mental Omega War is a currently ongoing global conflict involving Psicorps/Epsilon, the Allied Nations, Soviet Russia, Latin Confederation, China, the Revolt and Scorpion Cell. It began when Russia, recovering from the Third Great War, faced Yuri’s reborn Epsilon Army. Despite early Soviet victories, Epsilon destabilized the USSR and attacked Moscow and Stalington, formerly Washington, in 1984. As of now, it is still actively ongoing around the globe, as the Allies are making a daring counterattack at Yuri's Arctic fortress, while the soviets eye Yuri's moonbase, intending to take it over for themselves.

entries.name: Mercury Network Uplink
entries.content:
The american-built Mercury Network Uplink is a special satellite dish that establishes a connection with the network of Mercury Satellites that orbits the Earth. This allows an American force to fire strong laser beams on a target anywhere on the battlefield without additional designator units like the Athena.
It is used by the United States of America.

entries.name: Mercury satellite network
entries.content: The mercury satellite network is essentaily a network of low orbit ion cannons once used by the United States.

entries.name: MIDAS
entries.content: The MIDAS is a devastating ICBM developed in uranium facilities, capable of complete annihilation within its blast radius. Transported by mobile Topol-M launchers, it terrorized the world, particularly the Allies. Its smaller counterpart, the Tactical Nuke, requires fewer resources and sees wider use among factions. The Allies developed the Gladius Defense System to intercept MIDAS missiles, while Epsilon created the similar Spatha System. By the wars' end, all MIDAS missiles had been either destroyed or deployed, leaving none operational today.

entries.name: Mirage tank
entries.content:
Mirage Tanks are some of the most advanced anti-armor units in the Euro Alliance arsenal. Developed in the SteinsTech laboratories in Germany, this quad-tracked tank has the unique ability to camouflage itself as a tree as long as the tank is stationary. In addition to being undetectable on radar, this allows the Mirage Tank to remain hidden in plain view. With its Kinetic Energy Penetrator Cannon, the tank is more than a match for enemy armor, especially during ambushes. The battlefield is a dangerous place, but when even the trees are gunning for you, you know there is nowhere you can hide.
It is used by European Alliance.

entries.name: Missile bunker
entries.content: The neutral Missile Bunker is a neutral structure that, as its name suggests, provides those who captured it with tactical ballistic missiles.

entries.name: Morales
entries.content:
José "Morales" Arcadio Morales, a legendary Cuban assassin, rose from Castro's death squads to become the Confederation's most feared operative. His flawless accuracy and ruthless efficiency make him South America's top killer - politicians and generals have fallen to his rifle even under heavy guard.
He died during the Latin Confederation's assault on the Kashmiri Research base that was once home to Yunru, himself being evaporated by a MIDAS ICBM that was launched upon the fallen research base under orders from Yunru.

entries.name: Mortar quad
entries.content:
The concept of a fast anti-armor harasser has circulated through the halls of the Soviet army before, but never developed into fruition after the initial blueprints for an attack cycle went suddenly missing. The Latin Confederation however, has continued with a different, more improvised approach. Welding armor piercing mortars to high-powered quad bikes makes for a simple, yet effective way to destroy vehicles from a distance. The quads are now used by the Confederation mechanized infantry battalions in order to quickly destroy enemies from afar, often utilized from inside of their Catastrophes.
It is used by Latin Confederation.

entries.name: Mosquito boat
entries.content:
The Mosquito-class demolition boat, known in-game as Mosquito Demoboat, is a fast explosive Soviet ship filled with highly flammable substances that is used like a neo-fireship, a fast, lightly armored boat that rams enemy ships and detonates itself.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Nautilus
entries.content:
After realizing his Piranha minisubs couldn't match Allied naval power, Yuri revived the Nautilus-class—a massive submarine armed with magnetically-enhanced Type-M torpedoes far deadlier than Soviet Typhoons. Operating in stealth at extreme depths, it remains undetected while firing. Its magnetic field trap immobilizes nearby enemies, turning them into easy prey for Yuri's forces. With four deployed, these subs represent a quantum leap in Epsilon's underwater dominance, combining devastating firepower with tactical control of the battlefield.
It is used by all three Nautilus Subfactions.

entries.name: Navy SEAL
entries.content:
Navy SEALs are the elite soldiers of the Allied forces. Extensively trained in various weaponry, covert ops, and amphibious assaults, they are more than capable of handling most ground threats with their HK UMP submachineguns. They can use their C4 charges to quickly demolish enemy structures as well. SEALs are excellent for marine warfare as well, capable of detecting submerged enemy units and destroying ships with planted C4.
They are used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Neutraizer
entries.content:
The Neutralizer is a massive high-tech man-operated turret armed with, dual plasma cutters. It does not damage units in an area, but instead continuously deals damage over time with high precision plasma beams.
The plasma cutters make quick work of enemy mechanised divisions. What connects all of these advanced long-range defenses is their design flaw, their blind spot, right around the cannon itself. 
It is used by all three Foehn Subfactions.

entries.name: Neutral airfield
entries.content: The neutral Airfield is a neutral structure that can house up to four jet aircraft.

entries.name: Neutral buildings
entries.content: Neutral buildings are buildings scattered all over the battlefield or any area not fully controlled by either of the sides of the Mental Omega conflict. They belong to no one and because of that, any side of the conflict is able to freely take over and use them.

entries.name: Neutral nuclear plant
entries.content: The Tech Nuclear Plant is a neutral structure that, when captured, basically serve as a smaller and more secure version of Soviet Nuclear Reactors. While it only produces half as much as power as the Nuclear Reactor does, it does not explode as violently upon destruction and cannot be sabotaged like its conventional counterpart.

entries.name: Neutral ore refinery
entries.content: The neutral Ore Refinery is a neutral structure that processes ore and gems deposited by miners into cash.

entries.name: Neutral power plant
entries.content: The neutral Power Plant is a neutral structure that serves as an additional power source for commanders and proselytes when captured by their Engineers. Unlike regular power plants, its power grid cannot be sabotaged through infiltration.

entries.name: Norio Tomokawa
entries.content:
Tomokawa Norio began his career as an officer in the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Anti-Riot Squad before transitioning to Japan's elite Rocketeer division. His exceptional bravery accelerated his rise, earning him selection for Kanegawa Industries' cutting-edge Garuda power armor—a rare prototype.
The Garuda suit grants Norio high-speed flight, durability against anti-aircraft fire, and advanced weaponry: a cryo rifle to immobilize infantry and guided missiles to obliterate armor and aircraft. 
He is the main hero of the Pacific Front.

entries.name: Nuclear Missile Silo
entries.content:
For a long time, resolutions and treaties were created to limit the deployment of nuclear weaponry. Sadly, these agreements were cast out by the Soviets when they attacked the United States. The Tactical Nuke Silo builds, arms, and launches nuclear missiles. Infamous for its sheer destructive capabilities, the nuclear missile is an imposing weapon used only in the most dire of situations.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Nuclear Reactor
entries.content:
Though the Allies may have banned the use of nuclear fission for energy due to the high environmental risks it carries, the Soviets have no such qualms. A single Nuclear Reactor generates enough power to satisfy most of an average Soviet base's needs. However, they are large and vulnerable structures. Destruction of one will result in a cataclysmic meltdown and the resulting explosion can cripple a base.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Nuwa Cannon
entries.content:
The Nuwa Cannon is China's answer to poor siege capabilities—a monstrous super tank reclassified by Allied strategists as a "defense cannon" due to its overwhelming firepower and armor. Powered by a nuclear engine (with safeguards to prevent meltdowns), it fires depleted uranium shells from its fixed atomic cannon. Though slow and turretless, its sheer durability lets it spearhead assaults as a nearly impenetrable moving fortress. The Nuwa excels at absorbing enemy fire while obliterating advanced tanks and fortifications, making it a linchpin of Chinese armored warfare.
It is used by China.

entries.name: Oil Derrick
entries.content: In addition to the harvestable ore, you will always see Oil Derricks on the battlefield. Capturing these structures is the go-to option to gather additional funds for the war efforts on the field. Not only do the Oil Derricks provide a continuous flow of cash to your base - becoming its first owner gives a bonus amount of instant resources as well. The more Oil Derricks are capture,d the more cash a base of a specific faction will receive over time.

entries.name: Opus Tank
entries.content:
The Opus Tank emerged from Epsilon HQ's rushed development as an unexpected success, blending features of the Lasher and Mantis with an experimental dual-barrel turret (operated by a tank commander and infantry passenger). Initially conceived as a cutting-edge MBT, its design was compromised by shifting priorities and minimal testing. Yet, it proved ideal for combined arms warfare—enhancing firepower while doubling as protected transport for infantry. Despite its unconventional origins, the Opus became a versatile asset in Epsilon's arsenal, showcasing adaptability amid chaotic innovation.
It is used by Epsilon HQ.

entries.name: Ore
entries.content:
Ore is the primary means of earning money (or credits) in the battlefield. Ore is divided into 2 classifications; namely, Gold Ore and Gems.
Gold Ore is abundant, and more ore can be generated every 1 minute by an ore drill found in the middle of an ore field, essentially making Yellow Ore an infinite resource. Not all ore fields have an ore drill, however.
Ore can be gathered by special vehicles called Ore miners, or sometimes known as harvesters. Building more of these vehicles is critical to gain money quickly, whether by building them in War Factories or building an Ore Refinery, as each refinery comes with an ore miner.

entries.name: Ore Purifier
entries.content:
The Ore Purifier increases the value of every bail of ore a miner drops off at a refinery, effectively increasing the amount of funds an allied base receives by a large amount. It also provides the Allied base it is constructed at with a steady flow of cash regardless of circumstances. Additionally, the Ore Purifier acts as an extra deposit dock for all of the Allied harvesters.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Ore Refinery
entries.content:
The Ore Refinery is a technologically complex building completely outfitted to receive and process raw ore from miners, turn it into valuable metals and alloys, and instantly receive monetary transactions for other products while on the battlefield. This makes this structure a vital asset to base economy.
Each side and subfaction has their own aesthetically different ore refinery, but they all fulfill the same function, i.e. to process ore acquired via miners into materials which shall then be used to fund the ongoing war effort.

entries.name: Oxidizer
entries.content:
The Oxidizer is Scorpion Cell's ramshackle anti-aircraft vehicle, cobbled together from salvaged parts to save costs. This six-wheeled amphibious contraption fires corrosive acid capsules that dissolve aircraft but offers zero protection against ground threats. Its hazardous design—leaking chemicals and unstable construction—makes operating it a punishment duty, often assigned as disciplinary action. While brutally effective against air targets, the Oxidizer’s flimsy build and toxic internals reflect Scorpion Cell’s ruthless pragmatism—winning cheaply, even at the crew’s expense. 
It is used by Scorpion Cell.

entries.name: Pacific Front
entries.content: The Pacific Front, the newest Allied member, formed in response to China’s rising threat. Comprising Japan, South Korea, and Australia, it converted civilian tech into military assets with help from Kanegawa Industries. Internally divided, the Pacific Front featured factions with conflicting goals. Their arsenal included cryogenic weapons, long-range tech, and elite units like Norio Tomokawa in the Garuda armor. During the Third Great War, parts of the Pacific Front secretly allied with China, leading to occupation and betrayal. Loyalists resisted from Kyushu and aided Allied missions like the Paradox Project. After internal collapse and failed campaigns, surviving forces fled to Australia. In the Mental Omega War, these remnants regrouped with Allied forces as the “Boomerang Regiment,” aiding in key missions like defending the Weather Controller and evacuating through the Panama Canal, though the Pacific Front ceased to exist in East Asia due to occupation and disintegration.

entries.name: Palace
entries.content:
This majestic construct provides a Russian base with the most powerful technology their arsenal has to offer. Though the boons are many, the building is very costly and fragile, and should be well protected as the Soviet technology advancement method is simple but expensive.
It is used by all Russia.

entries.name: Paladin tank destroyer
entries.content:
The Paladin is a fast and resilient heavy tank, capable of faring against all types of ground targets (in spite of its designation as a tank destroyer). It specialized cannon makes it deadly to any kind of the ground vehicles, but infantry should also fear it. The Paladin is armed with 2 missile pods, which deal decent damage to any ground targets, but suffers from a longer reload rate.
It is used by European Alliance.

entries.name: Pandora Hub
entries.content:
The Pandora Hub is a tall and sleek building that serves as a central research laboratory for the most powerful of Epsilon technologies. In addition to providing the blueprints for Epsilon's most insidious machines, it also serves as an uplink for additional support powers. Such a vital building must be protected well and its secrets guarded safely from Yuri's enemies.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Paradox Engine
entries.content:
the Paradox Engine is the pinnacle of Allied technology—a colossal flying fortress armed with prism refractors and missile batteries for devastating multi-role attacks. As the Allies’ most durable airborne vessel, it dominates battles but remains vulnerable to focused anti-air fire.
Its deadliest weapon is Time Freeze, which immobilizes all enemies briefly, leaving them defenseless and enabling unstoppable Allied breakthroughs. The Engine also houses its own Chronosphere, linked to an internal pocket dimension, allowing instantaneous reinforcement teleportation.
However, it relies heavily on Paradox Batteries for power, requiring constant recharging. Its prism weapons also depend on rare Paradox Conductors from the pocket dimension. A game-changing but high-maintenance superweapon, the Paradox Engine reshapes battlefields—if its energy demands are met.

entries.name: Patriot Missiles
entries.content: The Patriot air-defense turret is essentially eight (four on each side of the turret) loaded patriot missile tubes that stands on a round turret basis. The Patriot Missiles are the standard anti-aircraft defense for the Allies. The missiles are guaranteed to hit their mark, and are the most powerful anti-aircraft defenses when it comes to damage per shot.

entries.name: Pillbox
entries.content:
The Pillbox is a simple, allied built, manned bunker armed with a heavy machine gun. Though it is effective at eliminating infantry and light vehicles, it lacks the firepower to easily destroy heavily armored units.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Piranha Minisub
entries.content:
The Piranha Minisub is a small and very fast submarine, designed as a general purpose combat vessel. Capable of a multitude of roles such as anti-aircraft and submarine warfare as well as shore assaults and ship killing, the Piranha is one of the most flexible naval units ever produced.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Plague Splatter
entries.content:
An age-old concept reborn: the Plague Splatter is essentially a catapult built on the hull of a mantis tank. Plague Splatters can catapult containers of highly corrosive agents and explosives across the battlefield, blasting open structures and eating away at the foundations. The projectiles leave poisonous vapors behind as a dangerous threat to infantry, causing respiratory distress and damage to internal and external organs. Cheaply produced, relatively quick, and lightly armored, the Plague Splatter is a powerful tool against both structures and infantry as long as it is placed out of harm's way. Be wary that the noxious gasses are just as lethal to the Scorpion Cell's own friendly forces!
It is used by Scorpion Cell.

entries.name: Power plant
entries.content:
The Power Plant is one of the Allies' most important structures, providing power to their bases. It is essentially a thermal power plant.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Premier Romanov
entries.content:
Premier Romanov was the Sovier Premier who started World War 3. Beneath his charismatic, peace-loving facade, Premier Romanov harbored deep hatred for the West, forged by wartime trauma. Manipulating both communist and tsarist ideals, he schemed to restore Soviet dominance. Allied intelligence, deceived by his act, installed him as a puppet premier to weaken the USSR—only for Romanov to secretly rearm it with Yuri’s help. He severed Allied spy networks, allied with communist states, and prepared for war.
Just as Soviet victory seemed certain, Yuri betrayed him, launching Epsilon’s coup during Moscow’s celebrations. Romanov’s reign ended abruptly, his dream of resurgence crushed by the very advisor who enabled it as he was killed by Malver, then working for Epsilon.

entries.name: Prism tank
entries.content:
The Prism Tank is essentially a prism turret fitted unto the hull of a cavalier tank. the Prism Tank is the go-to artillery equivalent for every European commander, bending light into a solid beam capable of inflicting great destructive force. Due to the hefty weight of the tank, the charge couplings usually built in Prism Towers were removed to allow for better mobility. This makes the Prism Tank ineffective against armored vehicles. The tank's prism refractor is not only effective at destroying enemy structures, but can also function as an anti-infantry weapon in a pinch.
It is used by European Alliance.

entries.name: Prism tower
entries.content:
The Prism Tower is the Allied advanced defense. A tall tower with an array of focusing mirrors at it's top, which are used to concentrate light into a powerful beam that cuts through armor, as well as ignite infantry. Prism Towers can link up with each other in order to increase the firing tower's damage output. This makes the Prism Tower an ideal defense to use in groups.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Proselyte
entries.content:
The Proselyte was alleged to be Yuri's second-in-command as well as the PsiCorps', and later, the Epsilon Army's, most skilled field commander, who led the PsiCorps and the Epsilon Army in their insidious operations throughout the Third Great War and key operations in the subsequent Mental Omega War.
Most of the details about the Proselyte have been shrouded in secrecy, and his name, background, and origins remain unknown.
The proselyte wears the black and purple uniform of an Epsilon general and a purple headscarf wrapped around his head like a hood.

entries.name: PsiCorps
entries.content: PsiCorps is the original and most powerful wing of the Epsilon Army, founded by Yuri during his time in the Soviet Union. Specializing in psychic technologies like mind control and telekinesis, PsiCorps compensates for its light armor with advanced mobility, anti-gravity propulsion, and gravity-based weapons. Their power is magnified by Libra, Yuri’s most potent psychic agent. Initially a Soviet secret unit, PsiCorps aided major operations including disabling U.S. nuclear capabilities and supporting allies like the Scorpion Cell. Over time, Yuri betrayed both Russia and China, manipulating global conflicts to build his own power. Following failed efforts in the Kremlin and an aborted MIDAS operation, PsiCorps broke away to help form the Epsilon Army. During the Mental Omega War, they launched psychic offensives in Europe, defended their tech from Allied and Soviet attacks, and continued developing devastating weapons, ultimately becoming a central force in Yuri’s bid for world domination.

entries.name: Psychic amplifier
entries.content:
The Psychic Amplifier is a large and tall Epsilon building/device able to mind control on a continental scale. It also boosts the influence of the Psychic Beacons, and serves as a control hub for them.
It is used by PsiCorps and Epsilon HQ.

entries.name: Psychic Beacon
entries.content:
The Psychic Beacon is an Epsilon-made structure/designed that is a a tall, rotating psychic positioned on a round superstructure/control room designed to mind control entire armies given enough time. Initially one of Yuri's many contributions to the Soviet cause, the Psychic Beacon was used to control Allied forces in America. The device was utilized extensively by the Soviets throughout the Third World War, and after Yuri's defection, by the Epsilon Army during the Mental Omega War.
The effects of the Psychic Beacons are boosted by a Psychic Amplifier, which also serves as a control hub for these Beacons.
It is used by PsiCorps and Epsilon HQ.

entries.name: Psychic Dominator
entries.content:
The Psychic Dominator is Epsilon's superweapon capable of unleashing a powerful psychic blast which destroys anything in its way and permanently mind controls anyone that is unfortunate enough to be at the blast's epicenter.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Psychic Tower
entries.content:
The Psychic Tower is a constantly rotating defensive tower much feared by Yuri's enemies. It is the pinnacle of his PsiCorps' mind control technology as while it can control multiple targets just like the Mastermind, it does not share its weakness in the form of willing to control more than it is capable of. Its mind control apparatus does not overload and will not result in a sudden self-destruction.
Once the Psychic Tower captures 3 objects, that's it, no more will be mind-controlled, until they are killed or the tower itself is disabled through some means, like low power or being hacked.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Pyro
entries.content:
Flamethrowers have been used by the Soviets in the Second Great War to terrorize local villages; torching man and structures to ashes. Now, known as Pyro, the flame-throwing infantry is making a comeback. The Soviet army has dug into its pockets in order to improve the effectiveness of Pyros by issuing standard flame retardant suits and longer ranged, more powerful flamethrowers. The Pyro is a definite threat to structures and groups of enemy infantry and is not to be underestimated. Their words are often muffled by the very gas masks they wear.
They are used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Qilin Tank
entries.content:
Although slow and rather expensive, the chinese-made Qilin Tank is the heaviest main battle tank of the entire Mental Omega war, possessing heavy-duty firepower in the form of its dual 115mm cannons. Symbolizing China's tactics of using immense armor and overwhelming force to crush its enemies, this unit retains its usefulness even in the late game stages against Tier 3 monster tanks (for starters, it has one tactical advantage over the Chinese Tier 3 Nuwa Cannon by being able to fire while moving). The tank's dual cannons punch through armor with ease, usually winning one-on-one standoffs with other MBTs, provided they can close the gap without taking too much damage beforehand.
It is used by China.

entries.name: Radar dish
entries.content:
The Soviet Radar Dish is essentially a modernized version of the Radar Dome from the previous war against the Allies - a fragile building equipped with a wide selection of electronics and surveillance devices. The Radar Dish provides soviet units with the radar mini-map and the access to more advanced technology.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Radar Dome
entries.content: The Radar Dome is a neutral structure that provides the owner with radar when captured.

entries.name: Radar Spire
entries.content:
Radar Spires provide the Epsilon commanders with a radar mini-map and clearance to use more potent technology, like the Mind Reader or Vision, which allow them to see through enemy movements. Additionally, it provides the use of genetically modified Ravens that function as advanced scouting units.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Rage Inductor
entries.content:
The Rage Inductor is an Epsilon drug laboratory, which manufactures a powerful mixture of aerosol steroids, bio-augmentative chemicals, and hormones known as the Terminus Drugs. Once the drugs have been prepared, they are loaded into a bomb, which is then deployed unto the battlefield via a Dybbuk aircraft, where it explodes into a powerful narcotic cloud, which enhances those epsilon troops who inhale it.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Rahn
entries.content:
Epsilon's pinnacle genetic experiment, Rahn is a superhuman commando forged from an elite soldier formerly captured by the Latin Confederation. Superior to Stalkers and Brutes, he combines unmatched combat prowess with tactical brilliance enhanced by rapid regeneration. Armed with a Terranova Virus-infused energy beam rifle, he shreds through armor and mutates enemy infantry into loyal Brutes.
Though intellectually gifted, Rahn masks his high intelligence behind bloodlust, fooling foes into underestimating him. He views Brute mutation as an "upgrade" for humanity and often disobeys orders to pursue carnage, dismissing proselytes' authority. A perfect killer yet unpredictable asset who follows his own personal ultra-darwinist philosophy, Rahn embodies Epsilon's lethal ambition—and its looming instability.
An incredibly tall, imposing and highly muscular figure, Rahn is always clad in full body black power armor, as well as a tubed gas mask attached to his full-face helmet.

entries.name: Rashidi
entries.content: An arab man in his late 40's with a pronounced grey beard and usually wearing green mecahnic clothes, Rashidi was a former middle eastern warlord repeatedly outmaneuvered the Allies despite overwhelming odds. During the Third Great War, he allied with Yuri, providing critical mobile construction tech in exchange for support against Allied forces—a partnership that later helped Yuri seize Russia. Rashidi’s gratitude toward Yuri soured after learning of a catastrophic Allied superweapon, prompting him to secretly start plotting to betray Epsilon.

entries.name: Reaper Corvette
entries.content:
The Reaper Corvette is a unique Soviet naval unit. The double radiation cannons they use can corrode the flesh of most enemy soldiers and the armor of ships, and can completely suppress infantry and light units. The Reaper Corvette also has an advantage in naval combat: With its amphibious capabilities, it can escape to land if it encounters threats such as heavy ships.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Regen drugs
entries.content:
Regen drugs are essentially a type of stimulant developed by the Epsilon forces. The main ability of this substance is to regenerate broken and wounded tissue and internal organs of those that are injected with them over a period of time. They can be acquired by Epsilon troops from their nearest Synthesis Vault.
They are used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Rejuvenator
entries.content: Constructed with advanced technology of unknown origins, by independent weapon developers, who value their anonymity, but will support you for the right price, the Rejuvenator is an advanced repair aircraft available at the Secret Lab. The one-of-a-kind support unit, it is an asset that all of the warring factions would appreciate as a mainstay of their arsenal, but somehow can't design on their own.

entries.name: Repair Crane
entries.content:
Cranes are simple buildings built in Soviet bases to automatically repair nearby friendly vehicles at regular intervals. Note that Cranes cannot remove Terror Drones, as a Repair Drone is needed for such a task. The repair effects of Cranes don't overlap, so there is no need to place them close to each other.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Repulsor
entries.content:
A master of infiltration, the Repulsor wields Yuri’s gravity-defying technology. His advanced charges affix to vehicles, creating a localized anti-gravity field upon detonation—flipping nearby machines skyward, with lighter units tumbling fastest. Hovercraft spin uncontrollably, often meeting destruction midair. The charge also damages its target; if destroyed prematurely, no field forms. Engineers can disarm the bomb like other explosives, but left unchecked, it devastates armor divisions. Though less potent than Libra’s psychic might, the Repulsor remains a dire threat to unsupported mechanized forces, turning gravity itself into a weapon.
It is used by PsiCorps.

entries.name: Resheph-class Ballistic Submarine
entries.content:
The Resheph-class ballistic submarine, known in-game as Resheph Ballistic Sub, is a capital submarine used by Epsilon to bombard enemy installations from a distance with its psychic decimator.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Rhino tank
entries.content:
During the Second Great War, the Soviet twin-barreled heavy tanks were the workhorse of the Soviet armor battalions, vastly overpowering the meager light and medium tanks the Allies had. Although they were powerful and heavily armored, they proved too costly to mass produce. This lead to the development of the relatively cheaper and quicker main battle tank, the Rhino Heavy Tank.
Although the Rhino packs less firepower and armor than its predecessor, it is still powerful enough to take on any main battle tank one-on-one. Its relatively higher speed and lower production costs make the Rhino a viable threat to any commander when amassed. To compensate for its shortcomings, for each three shells a special tesla-tipped one is used for greater spread and effectiveness against infantry. Visualy, it resembles a heavily modified T-10M heavy tank.
It is the main tank used by Soviet Russia.

entries.name: Riot trooper
entries.content:
The U.S. entered the Second Great War late, sending undertrained soldiers into brutal urban combat against battle-hardened Soviet troops, who excelled with spades, grenades, and submachine guns. After heavy losses, the U.S. adapted by equipping troops with shotguns, frag grenades, and urban warfare training. Years later, they developed Riot Troopers—specialized urban combat infantry with heavy flak jackets, riot shields, riotguns, and flashbangs to clear buildings. Despite their bulky armor, they remain amphibious, using inflatable rafts for surprise attacks.
They are used by the United States of America.

entries.name: Robot ops control center
keys: Pacific Front's robot ops control center
entries.content:
The Robot Ops Control Center is essentially three radar towers connected to a control building in the middle. It controls special, deployable Pacific Front drones: the Hunter-Seeker, in tandem with the Allied War Factories, and the standalone Zephyrobot.
It is used by the Pacific Front.

entries.name: Robot tank
entries.content:
The Robot Tank, originally a Japanese security droid, was upgraded by the Allies to counter Epsilon's mind control. Its hover jets allow naval patrols, while its rotating "Jupiter" laser turret efficiently eliminates psychic units. It also fires torpedoes over water and detects disguised infiltrators. Programmed with advanced friend-or-foe recognition, it excels in base defense and anti-personnel roles.
It is used by all three Alied Subfactions.

entries.name: Rocketeer
entries.content:
Rocketeers are brave individuals who hover far above the battlefield on their jetpacks, engaging ground and air targets with relative impunity via machineguns attached to the wrists of their rocketeer suit. Though their high speed and maneuverability makes them excellent scouts, they are very vulnerable to anti-air emplacements.
They are used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Runway
entries.content: The Runway is a simple landing strip, allowing aircraft to land and resupply.

entries.name: Soviet Russia
entries.content: Russia, the leading power of the Comintern and the world's largest nation, combines traditional armored strength with advanced mobile production to adapt to its vast terrain. Its military arsenal includes Tesla-based weapons developed after capturing Nikola Tesla during the Second Great War, giving rise to powerful units like the Tesla Cruiser and the enhanced hero Volkov. After initiating and losing the Second Great War, Russia rebuilt and launched the Third Great War, invading the U.S. and Europe and reclaiming territories. They used psychic tech and nuclear weapons, but faced setbacks in Europe and Asia, especially after tensions with China escalated into war. Though Russia emerged strong, its MIDAS weapons were no longer functional. Yuri’s betrayal and takeover of Moscow devastated the Soviet leadership, forcing remnants to regroup. Russia now relies heavily on cybernetic infantry, Tesla tech, and field production, with the Latin Confederation as its last major ally following broken ties with China.

entries.name: Saboteur
entries.content:
The Saboteur's main role is espionage: stealing important intelligence from enemy labs and facilities. Able to disguise himself as enemy infantry and slip past defenses, he is similar in that aspect to an Allied Spy. There is one major difference between the Saboteur and your regular espionage agent.
The Saboteur wears a vest with a low-yield bomb embedded within. The bomb's trigger is directly connected to a small heart rate monitor, which detonates the bomb when the Saboteur's heart stops. This contraption results in a localized explosion in the event the Saboteur is discovered and killed, either grievously wounding or killing the attacker.
They are used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: SAM bunker
entries.content: The SAM Bunker is a neutral defensive structure equipped with six heavy "Mauler" AA missiles that, when captured by an Engineer, is a superior version of the Tech SAM Site. Unlike the Tech SAM Site, it consumes some base power. Tech SAM Bunkers are massive anti-air defenses, which can easily take down almost any aerial threat at great ranges. This powerful defensive structure's only weakness is that it requires quite a bit of power.

entries.name: SAM site
entries.content: The SAM Site is a neutral defensive structure equipped with six surface-to-air "Redeye missiles" that, when captured, is basically a surface-to-air (SAM) missile site able to engage aircraft effectively.

entries.name: Satellite hack center
entries.content: The Satellite Hack Center is a neutral structure that, when captured, grants the owner a full battlefield view through the newly developed Global Positioning System (GPS). However, should the structure is destroyed or change control, its (previous) owner will completely lose their view of the battlefield except of their own forces.

entries.name: Scorpion Cell
entries.content: The Scorpion Cell is Epsilon’s Middle Eastern and African division, led by Rashidi and assassin Malver. Originating as a terrorist group using scrap-built weapons, they evolved after allying with Yuri, gaining advanced tech like Stalin’s Fist and PsiCorps support. Known for chemical warfare and ambush tactics, they overwhelm enemies with fast, low-cost units and deceptive weapons. During the Third Great War, they expelled Allied forces from Cairo, disrupted Soviet-Chinese alliances, and carried out espionage in Russia. In the Mental Omega War, they helped Yuri seize Russia and Africa, sabotaged Allied assets, and baited commanders into traps. However, heavy losses from Allied chrono tech and the Paradox Engine forced them into retreat. Despite salvaging research, the Cell faced decline, with Rashidi even contemplating switching sides as Epsilon’s fortunes waned.

entries.name: Scourge
entries.content:
With Rashidi's personal training and advanced weapon-crafting talents, the Scourges joined his ranks after the Scorpion Cell suffered a series of severe losses to heavy enemy armor on its own home territories. The custom weapon he is equipped with is extremely destructive to tanks, although its shots cannot be concentrated at a single point due to its strong recoil, making it a rather inaccurate weapon.
The key characteristic of the Scourge's weapon is that, shockingly to the Cell's enemies, it actually makes use of a short EMP effect.The scourges wear heavy and bulky exosuit-amplified armor with a special mask that protects their face from shrapnel.
It is used by Scorpion Cell.

entries.name: Scout Raven
entries.content:
Scout ravens are genetically modified ravens fully controlled by Epsilon commanders. They are used for efficient scouting and surveillance by Epsilon forces.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Scud launcher
entries.content:
The Scud Launcher is a tracked mobile loading and launching platform for tactical ballistic missiles. As is customary of the Soviet philosophy, firepower and armor are emphasized with this powerful siege engine, making it one of the most powerful long-range threats on the battlefield. A few direct hits from a Scud Launcher will cause even the sturdiest of buildings to collapse into a pile of rubble.
Unfortunately, due to the relatively slow speed of the projectile the missile can be shot down by anti-aircraft defenses. Another drawback is that even though the Scud Launcher is one of the heaviest armored artilleries, it is still vulnerable to enemy fire and shouldn't be left undefended.
It is used by Russia.

entries.name: Seawolf
entries.content:
Lacking an anti-aircraft ship in the previous war, the Soviets developed a fast sea raider known as the Seawolf Gunboat, capable of quickly destroying aircraft and harassing other ships. This multi-purpose attack craft has proven to be one of the Soviets more versatile naval vessels. Its turreted quad flak cannons and high caliber machinegun allow the Seawolf to engage both land and air targets.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Second Great War
entries.content: The Second Great War or GWII, also known as the Second World War or WWII, was a major armed conflict that began in 1946 and ended in 1953. It marks the first time where the Allies fought with the Soviets. The Allies were ultimately victorious at the end of the war, and the leader of the Soviets during that time, Stalin, was killed.

entries.name: Secret lab
entries.content: The Secret Lab contains unique technological concepts, designed by various weapon development groups, who sought independence from the warring nations' influence. Once captured, this building will grant you access to these engineers' latest invention, the support aircraft Rejuvenator.

entries.name: Sensor tower
entries.content:
The Soviet Sensor Tower was developed after Yuri's betrayal to counter his psi-tech. It reveals hidden threats—including invisible units, explosives, and spies—while its spotlight exposes enemies for increased damage.
Crucially, it disrupts enemy scouting abilities, blocking reconnaissance powers in its radius. A vital defense against deception, it safeguards Soviet bases from both psychological warfare and covert ops.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.content:
Aside from Halftracks, China lacked a dedicated advanced anti-aircraft system to protect their "crawling wall" of tanks. Filling this gap is the Sentinel, the guardian of the Chinese forces. Sentinels are sluggish six-wheeled vehicles whose two autocannons are loaded with modified white phosphor flak shells, which react violently with the air when impacting with a target, burning through metal in seconds. Being a specialized anti-aircraft weapon, the Sentinel can only fire upon aircraft in order to ensure maximum effectiveness.
It is used by China.

entries.name: Sentry gun
entries.content:
Sentry Guns are automated turrets outfitted with dual chain guns in order to combat enemy infantry and light vehicles. Though not equipped to deal with more heavily armored units, the Sentry Gun works well as a preliminary frontline defense of the Soviet outposts.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Shadow Tank
entries.content:
Epsilon HQ's triple-tracked Shadow Tank is a pinnacle of stealth warfare, using stolen Allied tech to remain permanently cloaked until firing its twin dissolver beams. Deadly against units (less so structures), it strikes unseen, forcing enemies to deploy detectors. A psychological terror weapon, it epitomizes Epsilon’s cunning—invisible, lethal, and unpredictable.
It is used by Epsilon HQ.

entries.name: Shield command
entries.content:
The European Alliance's Shield Command is a collection of one control room, a Force Shield generator and a lightning rod emergency generator, built on a round concrete base. It controls the Force Shield which can protect your structures from any sort of enemy attacks for a short while. It also provides the access to an emergency Lightning Rod, which is useful during power shortage situations.
It is used by European Alliance.

entries.name: Shock Trooper
entries.content:
In an ununsual call back to the original soldier, the new Russian Shock Trooper is their further improved version of the Tesla Trooper. He wears a thick armored exosuit, a stronger miniaturized tesla coil, and a rate of fire twice as fast as that of the Tesla Trooper. In addition, his bolt is capable of hitting more than one target.
These characteristics make the Shock Troopers appear more effective in countering larger numbers of enemy armor units in combat. Naturally, the Shock Troopers can also charge a Tesla Coil to enhance its bolt power and provide a short-term EMP effect, as well as benefit from the Overcharge.
It is used by Russia.

entries.name: Siege Cadre
entries.content:
The Siege Cadre is an Allied anti-structure infantry unit armed with a prism rifle, which is a smaller version of the Prism Tank's weapon, and wears thick, white, futurisitc armor with a full helmet which makes them immune to bites, scratches and makes them extra resistant against shrapnel..
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Siegfried
entries.content:
Siegfried is a German scientist in his mid-40s and a former associate of Albert Einstein. While Einstein advocated peaceful applications of his technology, Siegfried believes in weaponizing it to defend the free world. He wears a white protective suit and pilots the Zeitgeist, a massive chrono-tech craft armed with an advanced weapon that generates unstable chrono vortices, devastating enemies at range.
He is the European Alliance's hero.

entries.name: Siren Frigate
entries.content:
Due to frequent battles against Yuri's submerged fleets, the Allies had to design a new element of their navy, to prevent his subs from submerging and disappearing before anyone could even react. Thus, their scientists pulled a concept of a more powerful version of the Chrono Legionnaire's weapon on a new ship.
Equipped with a neutron blaster, the Siren Frigate lures passing ships into danger. Based on Kanegawa Industries' negation field technology, a new type of passive defense has been developed exclusively for this ship. When under enemy fire, it can pull the neutron blaster back and release the "Negation Shield", turning any damage dealt to the Siren into a reconstructive effect. However, its long-term eruption will put the Siren in an overloaded state and continuously damage its interior systems.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Smoke turret
entries.content:
Among the additional weapons, unique to the Latin Confederation, which rely on creating smoke screen, comes the Smoke Turret. This simple but useful contraption launches volleys of smoke projectiles from two automatic mortars which blind their enemies if they do not possess adequate navigation equipment. The Smoke Turret is cheap, effective and has great range. With enough spread of the weapon it fires, it can easily decrease the combat potential of incoming enemies, including some of the artillery units.
It is used by all three Latin Confederation Subfactions.

entries.name: Sniper
entries.content:
The Sniper is a type of European infantry who specialize in taking out enemy infantry from a distance without exposing their location by their AWP high-caliber bolt-action sniper rifles.
They are used by European Alliance.

entries.name: Soviet Airbase
entries.content:
Many long years have passed before the Soviets were able to restore their mighty airforce. Initially, during the Soviet invasion of the United States, the Red Army resorted to using giant blimps to bombard enemy positions from the skies but not many jets were seen. Finally after their attack on the American aeronautics complexes all over the country, necessary tech was acquired to develop the next-gen of Soviet jet fighters. The Soviet Airbase exists to produce and maintain them.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Soviet barracks
entries.content:
The towering statue of a Conscript that adorns this structure is meant to inspire awe and pride into any soldier serving the Soviet cause. A compact and instantly recognizable building, the soviet barracks house and provide training facilities to soviet infantry units.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Soviet naval shipyard
entries.content:
The Naval Shipyard is where the Soviet navy are assembled and maintained. It can also deploy naval mines around the battlefield as a deterrent to enemy ships.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Soviet Union
entries.content:
The Soviet Union (also known as the Soviets or the Comintern), was an economic, military and political alliance between various communist factions and governments in the world, led by Russia.
The Soviet Union consisted of three major subfactions: Russia, China and the Latin Confederation.
Soviet militaries often fielded massive quantities of heavy tanks to overwhelm their enemies with firepower. They were also infamous for utilizing controversial weapons such as suicide bombers, nuclear weapons, and flamethrowers. While not as technologically advanced as the the other factions, the Soviet military has nevertheless scored many victories by simply overpowering their rivals with conventional weapons. Their buildings and equipment have a much more industrial and brutalistic aesthetic with their main colors being red, orange, tan, maroon, brown, crimson and yellow.

entries.name: Soviet war factory
entries.content:
Perhaps one of the most vital buildings for the Soviets. The War Factory allows the construction of a myriad of armored vehicles on the battlefield, which the Soviets use to steamroll their opponents.
It is used by all three Soviet Subfactions.

entries.name: Speeder Trike
entries.content:
In spite of its appearance as a little three-wheeled bike, the Speeder Trike is a deadly anti-armor unit in the hands of the Scorpion Cell. The Trike can easily outrange most conventional weaponry with its long-range RPG-S launcher and is quick enough to outmaneuver most vehicles, also capable of switching into firing its triple projectiles simultaneously at high altitudes, making it a formidable foe in combat. Its armor is less than stellar though, so it should avoid direct hits from anti-tank weaponry.
It is used by Scorpion Cell.

entries.name: Stalin's fist
entries.content:
Heavy armor has always been a focus point for Soviet military vehicles. This does bring several problems with logistics, as heavier units are slow and take longer to reach their destination, which can very much mean victory or defeat on the battlefield. The Russians came with a surprisingly complicated solution.
A massive vehicle based on mobile construction, the same technology used by the MCV's, that could deploy into an assembly line in order to produce vehicles from. This moving War Factory, named Stalin's Fist, allows russian armies to churn out tanks right on the doorstep of their enemies. Although these machines are expensive and very limited in numbers, they provide a unique strategic advantage to the Russians.
It is used by Russia.

entries.name: Stalker
entries.content:
Epsilon’s most successful genetic experiments, Stalkers are hulking, intelligent brutes armored in reinforced bulky full-body black suits with dual integrated weapons and six visor-holes on their round,spherical helmets. Their immense strength lets them wield the devastating "Meteor" cannon, collapsing structures with sheer firepower. A secondary arm-cannon drains psychic energy from enemies, slowing them while fueling nearby allies’ regeneration.
Tougher than their failed kin (like the Brutes), Stalkers serve as mobile artillery, unstoppable under Epsilon’s enhancements. Paired with melee infantry and HQ support, they form an overwhelming assault force—crushing defenses and draining foes into submission.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Stallion Transport
entries.content:
The large Stallion Transport helicopter is one of Sikorsky corporation's finest transport helicopters and a standard in all Allied armies. Its large passenger capacity, coupled with radar invisibility, allows it to easily insert infantry battalions behind enemy lines.
It is used by all three Allied Subfactions.

entries.name: Steinstech
entries.content: SteinsTech, a European Alliance tech firm led by Germany and Siegfried, is renowned for chrono technology from Einstein’s research. During the Third Great War, their weapons helped resist Soviet invasions, but Soviet strikes destroyed key facilities after a Canadian intel leak. Surviving staff fled to Britain and joined Kanegawa Industries to develop the Paradox Project. After two years, an Epsilon assault forced early activation of the Paradox Engine, a massive airborne fortress that evacuated Allied personnel. This event marked SteinsTech’s evolution into FutureTech, launching a new chapter in advanced weapons development.

entries.name: Stinger
entries.content:
Another great Rashidi's invention, the Stinger, is an unmanned, robotic walker that crawls on four mechanical limbs and is used to swiftly transport infantry across the battlefield. Though it can only transport a single infantry, the Stinger makes up for it in versatality, armed with an acid sprayer to decimate infantry with and lightly damage vehicles.
Along with sensors to detect stealth and disguises, the Stinger functions as the Epsilon's main repair vehicle when an Engineer is on board. As flexible as it is, the Stinger lacks in raw armor and firepower, its acid doing negligible damage to structures.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Stormchild
entries.content:
The Stormchild is an advanced delta-winged jet fighter with canards, specifically equipped to efficiently deal with fast moving targets. With its high-tech lasers and powerful targeting systems, it's theoretically impossible for the fighter to miss its target. Its plentiful missiles benefit from the targeting systems as well, though they cause less damage individually than comparable warheads. Although the Stormchild is one of the fastest fighters in the Allied arsenal, it is rather fragile in the face of anti-aircraft fire. Due to a low radar cross-section, the fighter is invisible on enemy radars, giving the Stormchild the element of surprise.
It is used by the United States of America.

entries.name: Stryker IFV
entries.content:
The Stryker Infantry Fighting Vehicle (or the Stryker IFV for short) is the newest development in multipurpose support vehicles. It is an eight-wheeled armored vehicle that comes equipped with standard light anti-armor missiles capable of accurately taking down enemy aircraft with great ease even while on the move. Its great speed, the highest among its peers, allows it to effectively perform hit and run tactics.
But the Stryker's greatest strength lies in its ability to adapt to almost any situation presented to an Allied commander. This vehicle houses a complex weapons system which allows any infantry that enters it to integrate their weapon into the turret of the Stryker. Because of that, the Stryker's weaponry automatically changes depending on what type of infantryman is operating it.
It is used by the United States of America.

entries.name: Suppressor
entries.content:
The Suppressor is a Pacific Front amphibious combat specialist infantry unit type that are capable of converting incoming damage into healing for friendly troops using a compact version of a specialized piece of equipment called the "Negation Field". This device is capable of reverting the destructive nature of every projectile to point, where attacking would simply heal the target - with an opposite result for any repairing or healing tool.instead, making them unusually valuable. They usually float into battle on their specialized V-shaped hoverboards, giving them all-terain and even amphibious qualities.
It is used by Pacific Front.

entries.name: Synthesis Vault
entries.content:
Synthesis Vault is a tall tower with several bio-reactors attached to it's top. it is used by Yuri's forces for basic biological research and material processing. His unique infantry treatment drugs are distributed from this building, with both fundamental and advanced types. In addition, the special materials synthesized through this building can also be used to build Tank Bunkers as well as deploy the Ruiner of Epsilon HQ. What's more, the synthetic energy emitted from this structure is conducted through the Tank Bunkers nearby, actively reinforcing their internal structure.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Tank Bunker
entries.content:
Tank Bunkers are structures, which most turreted vehicles can enter to gain additional protection from enemy fire while still being able to retaliate. Though the occupier of a Bunker will become a much more difficult target to destroy for ground forces, aerial attacks will still easily bypass these entrenchments. Tank Bunkers built nearby a Synthesis Vault can get their armor reinforced with supplemental active field coming from the Vault.
It is used by all three Epsilon Subfactions.

entries.name: Tanya Adams
entries.content:
Tanya Adams is a mysterious and legendary tomboyish U.S. special agent whose true origins are known only to a few now high-ranking officials
A lean, muscular operative with short brown hair, Tanya wears a tank top, camo cargo pants, a utility belt, and combat boots. Her signature weapon is an early miniaturized laser capable of slicing through tanks, ships, and flesh effortlessly. She also carries C4 charges, allowing her to demolish enemy structures instantly. This combination makes her a deadly force in any combat scenario, on land or at sea.

entries.name: Tech Center
entries.content:
Together with the subfaction-specific technology expansion buildings like the Mercury Network Uplink, the Shield Command and Robot Ops Control Center, the Allied Tech Center unlocks the most potent technologies and weapons the Allies have to offer to a commander.
The Tech Center is a tall glass building with many laboratories and research facilities inside. It also allows the allies to release the Black Widow or its Alpha variant.
